title: W11 aggregation pin never asserts drops land ON the shared uplink bundle — the positive location half of the card's contract is unpinned
detail: Pin (b) asserts congestion exists and is never at an access bundle, but by_bundle is only filtered against narrow; drops at the host's wide drop (pipe 12) would also pass, weakening the 'shared link congests' half.
recommended_fix: After the run, resolve pipe 13's bundle via bundle_of_pipe and assert by_bundle[shared_bundle] > 0, so the choke's location — the shared standard uplink — bites positively.

title: Headroom band pin binds the in-code test fixture, not data/pipe_tiers.json — a data-only retune bypasses the unit band
evidence:
cat := test_catalog(&cat_storage)
	defer catalogs_destroy(cat)
	narrow, ok := pipe_tier_index(cat, "narrow")
--- determinism_test.odin:42 ---
	append(&cat.pipe_tiers, Pipe_Tier{id = "narrow", display = "Narrow Copper", capacity_units = 10, cost = 20, clean_span = 8, max_span = 10, cost_per_tile = 5, era_introduced = 1})
--- data/pipe_tiers.json:7 ---
      "capacity_units": 10,
detail: The comment claims the pin 'holds the pick inside the card's band … so a future retune cannot silently undershoot', but it reads the synced fixture. A data-only retune to 7 trips only the golden catalog-hash gate, not this band.
recommended_fix: Add a harness-level check (core is file-IO-free by ODN-1) asserting data/pipe_tiers.json's narrow capacity satisfies the 3200–4000 permille band, binding the unit pin to production data.

title: Stale '5+40' capacity prose and failure message in routing_cost_test bundle-min-member pin (narrow is now 10, sum 50)
detail: The assertion itself is dynamic (correct, passes at 10+40=50), but the (d) comment, header comment line 233, and the expectf message hardcode '5+40' — a future failure would report a wrong expected value.
recommended_fix: Reword the three stale spots (lines 233, 291, 295) to 'narrow+wide member sum' or interpolate the tiers, matching the dynamic assertion post-5.10.
